title: Smart Water Faucet with Far-UV Disinfection and Automatic Soap and Sanitizer Dispenser
summary: A sensor-controlled hygiene system combining touchless water delivery, automatic soap and sanitizer dispensing, and an optional far-UV disinfection concept within an integrated faucet architecture. The invention addresses multidisciplinary engineering challenges involving fluid delivery, sensing, automated control and human interaction.
originalAssignee: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
